extraction.title: Altered state
extraction.subtitle: Donald Trump is giving psychedelic medicines a welcome boost But his methods could prove damaging
extraction.summary: Donald Trump's executive order to expedite FDA approval for psychedelic drugs marks a significant shift in drug policy, prioritizing relationships over scientific merit. This move has raised share prices of psychedelic companies and promises new funding for research, but also highlights potential risks and political implications in drug development.
